Runs down the path and awards cash on death.|In-Game Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Money Runner''' is one of the two first units spawned by the [[Kingpin]]. It receives three upgrades, one when the [[Kingpin]] is upgraded to Level 4A, one when upgraded to Level 5A and one when upgraded to Level 6A. Like most other units, it starts from one of the entrances of the map and moves towards the exit. Unlike other units, the '''Money Runner''' is not used for defending against enemies, instead on death it gives a handful of cash. Depending on the level, the '''Money Runner''' can generate from {{Money|200}} to {{Money|850}}. ==Appearance== The '''Money Runner''' has pale skin and ginger hair. It wears a white shirt with a blue vest over it. A red tie is worn with brown pants, gloves, and dapper hat. It is also seen to carry a brown briefcase with money inside of it. ==Stats== {{neow| $IPS$ = Cash on Death / Spawn Time $RDPS$ = Health / Spawn Time
